fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Steepening curve (2s10s +41bp) with easing Fed (funds 3.63% vs 10Y 4.75%) favors curve-sensitive financials and real assets; software/cyber names are being repriced hard (PANW -10.6%, CRWD -5.9%, DDOG -6.3%) — we have no edge in catching those knives. Small book, high cash, defined risk.
fable.justification: Hold both existing positions: XLE's energy exposure is consistent with a steep-curve, real-asset regime, and XLU is the defensive ballast — both are near entry with intact mechanisms. One new thesis only: XLF long on the structural lag between the now-steep curve and bank re-rating; generalists spent 2023-2025 underweight banks during inversion and re-rate slowly (the structural donor of the alpha). No crypto position — BTC at 77k offers no declared edge, and 'I don't know' is an answer. The X/Twitter feed is stale (dated Aug 26, treats NVDA earnings as upcoming) and is logged as unreliable input, not evidence. 78% cash is a position, not indecision.

positions.thesis: HOLD — energy remains under-owned by generalist mandates while curve steepening and sticky 10Y at 4.75% support real-asset allocations; mechanism intact, position near entry.
positions.invalidation: We are wrong if XLE closes below $60.60 (-7%), or if crude weakness drives XLE to underperform SPY by >5% over 30 days without a broad risk-off move, by 2026-10-31.

sol.thesis: Flat: a steep curve, 4.75% 10-year yield, normal volatility, and conflicting tech price action offer no verified asymmetric edge on 2026-09-02.
sol.justification: No positions require holding or selling because the current book is flat. New entries are blocked because prices were not confirmed by two independent sources, while the research feed contains stale August 26 references and incorrectly frames already-reported Nvidia earnings as upcoming. Preserving cash is preferable to underwriting trades from temporally inconsistent evidence.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Cash is the position: a steep curve (10Y 4.75% vs funds 3.63%) and VIX 16.3 into the Sept 15–16 FOMC do not, by themselves, identify a mispriced instrument.
grok.justification: The book is flat with no live thesis to re-underwrite. Single-day selloffs in PANW/CRWD/DDOG/NET/PLTR and a post-print NVDA bounce are prints, not edges—no named payer of alpha, no pre-written falsifier, no costed EV. Cold-start sizing and ¼-Kelly with uncalibrated probabilities make inventing exposure a process error. Survive, measure, then compound; no action this cycle.

gemini.thesis: Steepening yield curve (2s10s at +41 bps) and sticky long-end yields (10Y at 4.75%) favor real assets, cash-flow generative infrastructure, and defensive quality over multiple-expanded high-beta SaaS.
gemini.justification: Software multiples are facing acute margin and valuation compression as long-end yields stay firm at 4.75%, while capital is rotating toward cash-generative secular infrastructure (ORCL, NVDA), structural payment rails (V), defensive consumer staples (XLP, WMT), healthcare (UNH), and real assets (XLE, DE, BTC). We hold our diversified 9-position book with 22% cash dry powder to respect correlation cluster constraints and survive volatility ahead of the mid-September FOMC.

glm.thesis: Cautious grind-higher regime into the Sept 15-16 FOMC: hold the diversified core, add small post-earnings-drift and sympathy-reversion longs, keep the index-concentration put, and leave roughly half the book in cash.
glm.justification: All six existing longs were reviewed against invalidation first — none is breached, all marked roughly flat, so this cycle's job is review-then-add, not churn. Note the research feed is stale (Aug 26): NVDA earnings are already resolved, so the drift thesis is grounded in today's +3.4% tape, not an upcoming event. New risk is confined to three behavioral trades (NVDA post-earnings drift, CRWD no-news sympathy selloff, BTC capitulation washout), each sized ≤5% with ≤50bps of NAV at the stop. ~55% stays in cash ahead of the September 15-16 FOMC and the next inflation reading, and the QQQ put is retained as the sole hedge against a top-heavy index whose gains are concentrated in two firms.

Structural edge in energy (supply constraints) and behavioral edge in mean-reverting AI names justify positioning.
